	6.	Celiac genetic HLA haplotype
HLA-DQ2 HLA-DQ8
Cellular assay/MLC to test HLA 
class II types
HLA-DQ2 and HLA-DQ8 positive  
indicates a low positive predictive 
value but a very high negative  
predictive value for celiac disease. 
Higher prevalence of CD in pa-
tients with Type 1 DM or autoim-
mune thyroid disease (2%-4%) 
than in general population
Genotype:
HLA DQ2 negative
HLA DQ8 negative
More than 97% of individuals 
with celiac disease share the 
two HLA markers DQ2 and 
DQ8, which have high sensitiv-
ity and poor specificity. One of 
the markers can increase  
possible non-celiac gluten  
sensitivity (e.g., Type 1 DM 
DQA1*0501:DQB1*0201
